points.text: A Reuters/Ipsos poll put President Donald Trump’s approval at 31%, a record low, and showed Democrats leading Republicans 47% to 35% on the congressional ballot.
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel and met Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu amid discussion of a possible resumption of the Iran war.
A Google Cloud outage in London disrupted services at several UK banks, including Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC, with Revolut customers reporting payment and ATM problems.
Alberta voters rejected a move toward independence and backed remaining part of Canada in the province’s referendum.
Tesla and SpaceX formed special committees to discuss a possible merger, according to Elon Musk, who leads both companies.
